headline.zh-CN: 首页曲目按专辑曲序排列
headline.en: Dashboard tracks follow album track order

summary.zh-CN: 修复首页专辑分组内的曲目排序，使曲目按照专辑内已排好的曲序显示。
summary.en: Tracks grouped under each album on the Dashboard now follow the album's configured track order.

title.zh-CN: 首页曲目列表按专辑曲序排列
title.en: Album track order in Dashboard track list

description.zh-CN: 首页各专辑分组下的曲目现已按专辑设定的曲号升序排列，未设置曲号的曲目排在最后。
description.en: Tracks under each album group on the Dashboard are now sorted by album track number ascending, with unnumbered tracks placed last.
